summary: Hiker from Montrose wandered off the Blue Lakes Trail in stormy, snowy late-afternoon conditions and called 911; three field teams located him via whistle/voice contact and escorted him to the trailhead uninjured.
notes: Teams on scene ~6 p.m.; subject found cold but uninjured, escorted out by ~10:30 p.m. Team used new search dog Rosa and a missing-persons-behavior method.
